reports.headline: National turnout reaches 40.07%
reports.summary: Vedomosti reports the CEC nationwide figure as of 18:27 Moscow time; federal DEG participation was 80% at 16:34.

reports.headline: How online voting is progressing in the State Duma election
reports.summary: RBC's live map reports more than 3.3 million federal-platform votes from just over 4 million registrations, and about 2.8 million Moscow online votes from 7.8 million eligible voters.

reports.headline: Russian election observer loses consciousness during arrest by police, opposition party says
CEC says more than 3.1 million voted on the federal DEG platform
reports.summary: The official post says more than four million people had registered for federal remote electronic voting across 32 regions outside Moscow.

reports.headline: Public Chamber monitor lists two confirmed deviations
reports.summary: 296 hotline appeals · 238 deviations reported · 2 confirmed · 129 unconfirmed · 9 resolved · 98 under review. These are the monitor's own classifications.

reports.headline: Novaya Gazeta Europe · Election 2026 live coverage
reports.summary: Novaya Gazeta Europe's live election page collects its reporting, analysis and commentary in one updating feed.

reports.headline: Meduza tracks DEG failures, coercion claims and observer access
reports.summary: The updating report compiles linked accounts from the first day of voting and clearly identifies the claims and their original sources.

reports.headline: DOXA reports DEG failures and observers denied access
reports.summary: The article attributes reports about technical queues, pressure to vote and polling-station access problems to named parties, local outlets and observers.
